name: get_user
title: Get current user
description: Who is signed in and the courses they can see. Use when a request is vague or you need to learn how this Ed site names its courses. Not for course details beyond id, code, name and status (same list as list_courses). Then pass a course id or code to any courseId argument. Cost: small.

name: list_courses
title: List courses
description: Enrolled courses with id, code, name and status; archived courses omitted unless includeArchived. Use when the user asks what they are enrolled in, or names a course you cannot resolve. Then use the id or the code exactly as returned as courseId. Cost: small.

includeArchived.description: Also return courses Ed marks as archived; defaults to false.

name: list_lessons
title: List lessons
description: Compact lesson summaries for one course: id, title, module, type, state, progress. Use when the user asks which lessons, modules or weeks exist, or what is unfinished. Call without filters first; an empty list means the course has no Ed Lessons. Filters are case-insensitive; pass all or omit a filter to include every value. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Then get_lesson for slides, list_lesson_files for downloads, mark_lessons_read to update progress. Cost: about 100 bytes per lesson.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

lessonType.description: Exact lesson type, for example "general". Use "all" or omit to include every type.

module.description: Module ID or case-insensitive text from the module name as Ed shows it. Use "all" or omit to include every module.

state.description: Exact availability state, for example "active" or "scheduled". Use "all" or omit to include every state.

status.description: Exact progress status: "unattempted", "attempted", or "completed". Use "all" or omit to include every status.

name: get_lesson
title: Get lesson
description: One lesson with its slides and slide content. Use when the user asks what a lesson says or you need a slide id. Not for downloadable files (list_lesson_files) or quiz questions (list_slide_questions). lessonId comes from list_lessons. Cost: large for long lessons.

lessonId.description: Ed lesson ID as returned by list_lessons.

name: list_lesson_files
title: List lesson files
description: Ed-hosted downloadable files and direct resource links for one lesson, returned as resource links. Use when the user wants slides, PDFs or attachments. Not for external links inside lesson text (get_lesson). lessonId comes from list_lessons. Cost: small.

lessonId.description: Ed lesson ID as returned by list_lessons.

name: list_thread_files
title: List thread files
description: Ed-hosted downloadable files and direct resource links attached to one thread, including its answers and comments, returned as resource links. Use when the user wants attachments from a thread. threadId is the global id from list_threads. Cost: small.

threadId.description: Global thread ID as returned by list_threads.

name: list_slide_questions
title: List slide questions
description: Quiz questions for one lesson slide with one-based choice numbers. Use when the user wants to see or answer a quiz. slideId comes from get_lesson. Then submit_slide_answer per question, then submit_slide. Cost: small.

slideId.description: Ed slide ID as returned by get_lesson.

name: list_slide_responses
title: List slide responses
description: Saved quiz responses for one lesson slide. Use when the user asks what they answered or whether a quiz is submitted. slideId comes from get_lesson. Cost: small.

slideId.description: Ed slide ID as returned by get_lesson.

name: get_slide
title: Get slide
description: One lesson slide with its content as structured data. Use when you already have a slide id and need only that slide rather than the whole lesson. slideId comes from get_lesson. For prose, prefer read_slide. Cost: small to medium.

slideId.description: Ed slide ID as returned by get_lesson.

name: list_threads
title: List threads
description: Compact thread summaries for one course: id, number, title, category, answered state. Use when the user asks what is being discussed or wants a thread by title. Categories are hierarchical: category is top-level and subcategory is second-level, spelled as Ed shows them. Sort defaults to new; Ed may keep pinned threads first. Not for thread bodies (get_thread) or the user's own posts (list_activity). courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: about 150 bytes per thread; use limit.

answered.description: Keep answered threads when true, unanswered when false; omit for both.

category.description: Exact top-level category as Ed shows it.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

limit.description: Maximum threads to return, capped at 100; defaults to 30.

offset.description: Threads to skip in the unfiltered Ed stream before filtering.

since.description: Only threads created at or after this time: an ISO date such as "2026-09-01", an ISO datetime such as "2026-09-01T10:00:00Z", or a relative offset such as "7d", "12h", or "2w".

sort.description: Ed sort order. Defaults to "new"; Ed may keep pinned threads ahead of that order.

subcategory.description: Exact second-level subcategory as Ed shows it.

threadType.description: Exact thread type, for example "question" or "post".

name: search_threads
title: Search threads
description: Threads in one course whose title or body contains every query word, case-insensitively. Use when the user asks about a topic rather than a thread number. Ed is paged client-side until limit threads match; accepts the same filters as list_threads. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Then get_thread or read_thread for the body. Cost: several Ed pages for rare words; use limit and since.

answered.description: Keep answered threads when true, unanswered when false; omit for both.

category.description: Exact top-level category as Ed shows it.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

limit.description: Maximum threads to return, capped at 100; defaults to 30.

offset.description: Threads to skip in the unfiltered Ed stream before filtering.

since.description: Only threads created at or after this time: an ISO date such as "2026-09-01", an ISO datetime such as "2026-09-01T10:00:00Z", or a relative offset such as "7d", "12h", or "2w".

sort.description: Ed sort order. Defaults to "new"; Ed may keep pinned threads ahead of that order.

subcategory.description: Exact second-level subcategory as Ed shows it.

threadType.description: Exact thread type, for example "question" or "post".

query.description: Words that must all appear, case-insensitively, in the thread title or body.

name: get_thread
title: Get thread
description: One thread with its answers and comments, compact. Use when the user wants what a thread says. threadId is the global id from list_threads or list_activity; for a course-local number such as #42 use get_course_thread. Cost: proportional to replies.

includeHtml.description: Also return Ed's XML content; the plain-text document is always returned.

threadId.description: Global Ed thread ID as returned by list_threads; for the number shown inside a course use get_course_thread.

name: get_course_thread
title: Get thread by course number
description: One thread addressed by course and course-local number (the #N Ed shows), compact. Use when the user gives a thread number rather than a global id. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: as get_thread.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

includeHtml.description: Also return Ed's XML content; the plain-text document is always returned.

number.description: One-based thread number as shown inside the course, the #N in the Ed thread list.

name: list_activity
title: List my activity
description: The signed-in user's recent threads, answers and comments, optionally within one course. Use when the user asks what they posted or whether anyone replied. Not for other people's activity (list_threads). courseId is optional and accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: small.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, or the course code exactly as Ed shows it, to filter by. Omit for every course.

filterType.description: Kind of activity to keep. Defaults to "all".

limit.description: Maximum items, capped at 50; defaults to 30.

name: read_thread
title: Read thread
description: One thread with its answers and comments as Markdown. Use when the user wants to read a thread rather than inspect its fields. Pass either threadId, or courseId plus the course-local number (the #N Ed shows). Cost: proportional to replies.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

threadId.description: Global Ed thread ID; use instead of courseId and number.

name: read_lesson
title: Read lesson
description: One lesson and its slides as Markdown. Use when the user wants to read or summarise a lesson. lessonId comes from list_lessons. Not for files (list_lesson_files) or quiz questions (list_slide_questions). Cost: large for long lessons.

name: read_slide
title: Read slide
description: One lesson slide as Markdown. Use when the user wants to read a single slide. slideId comes from get_lesson. Cost: small to medium.

name: mark_lessons_read
title: Mark lessons read
description: Mark lessons and their slides as read; writes progress. Use only when the user explicitly asks to mark lessons read or complete. queries are words that must appear in lesson or module names; no queries means every lesson in the course. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: one write per slide.

all.description: Mark every lesson in the course; required when queries is empty.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds to pause after each slide, 0 to 10; defaults to 0. Raise it to go easy on Ed.

queries.description: Case-insensitive substrings that must all appear in the lesson title or module name; at most 10. When queries is empty, all must be true to mark every lesson of the course.

name: submit_slide_answer
title: Submit slide answer
description: Save one-based choices for one quiz question; writes. Use only when the user has chosen the answer. questionId comes from list_slide_questions. Then submit_slide to finalise the slide. Cost: one write.

amend.description: Overwrite an answer already saved for this question; defaults to false.

choices.description: One-based answer indexes as shown by list_slide_questions; pass several for multiple-selection questions.

questionId.description: Ed question ID as returned by list_slide_questions.

name: submit_slide
title: Submit slide
description: Submit all saved answers for one quiz slide; writes and is usually final. Use only with explicit user intent after answers are saved. slideId comes from get_lesson. Cost: one write.

slideId.description: Ed slide ID whose saved answers are submitted, as returned by get_lesson.

name: create_thread
title: Create thread
description: Create a thread in one course; posts publicly as the token owner and cannot be removed from here. Use only when the user explicitly asks to post and has approved the title and body. body is Markdown and is converted to Ed's document format. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: one write.

anonymous.description: Hide the author name from other students. Staff can still see it.

body.description: Post body in Markdown. It is converted to Ed's document format before posting.

category.description: Exact top-level category for the course as Ed shows it.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

private.description: Post privately to course staff instead of the whole course.

title.description: Thread title shown in the course thread list.

type.description: Ed thread type. Use "question" to ask, "post" to discuss; "announcement" needs staff rights.

name: reply_thread
title: Reply to thread
description: Reply to one thread, or to one comment inside it; posts publicly as the token owner and cannot be removed from here. Use only when the user explicitly asks to reply and has approved the body. body is Markdown and is converted to Ed's document format. threadId is the global id. Cost: one write.

anonymous.description: Hide the author name from other students. Staff can still see it.

as.description: Reply kind. Defaults to "answer" on question threads and "comment" elsewhere.

body.description: Reply body in Markdown. It is converted to Ed's document format before posting.

private.description: Post privately to course staff instead of the whole course.

threadId.description: Global Ed thread ID to reply to.

toCommentId.description: Reply under this comment of the thread instead of at the top level. The comment must belong to threadId.

name: list_modules
title: List lesson modules
description: Lesson modules of one course with the number of lessons in each. Use when the user asks which weeks or modules exist, or to pick a module value for list_lessons. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Cost: small.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

name: show_forum_catchup
title: Catch up on the forum
description: Interactive catch-up view of one course forum: unread announcements, then the threads from the last days (default 14) that are new to the user or have new replies, each expandable in place. Use first when the user asks what they missed, what is new, or to catch up on a course; hosts without interactive views get the same list as text. Not for plain-text answers when the user asks for text (list_threads), or finding a topic (search_threads). courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Then add one or two sentences on what stands out; do not repeat the list. Cost: one to a few Ed pages.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

days.description: How many days back to look; defaults to 14.

name: show_thread_activity
title: Chart forum activity
description: Interactive weekly chart of new threads in one course over the last weeks (default 12), stacked by category, with each week expandable to its busiest threads; announcements and pinned threads are excluded. Use when the user asks what people are asking about, when the forum gets busy, or how discussion changed over the term. Not for individual threads (list_threads) or plain-text answers when the user asks for text. courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Then name the one or two patterns worth noticing. Cost: up to ten Ed pages.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

weeks.description: How many weeks back to chart; defaults to 12.

name: show_lesson_progress
title: Show lesson progress
description: Interactive progress view of one course's Ed Lessons: completed of total for each released module in release order, its unfinished lessons on click, and a count of modules not released yet. Use when the user asks what they are behind on, what is left, or how far through the lessons they are. Not for plain-text answers when the user asks for text (list_lessons). courseId accepts a numeric ID, a unit code, or part of the unit name. Then say where to start; do not repeat the numbers. Cost: one Ed request.

courseId.description: Ed course ID, the unit code as Ed shows it, or part of the unit name (see list_courses). Do not assume a code format.

name: show_lesson_guide
title: Teach a lesson
description: Show a study guide you wrote for one lesson as a step-through card, then a short practice quiz that the user answers and the widget grades in place. Use when the user asks to be taught, walked through, or quizzed on a lesson or topic. First read_lesson; then pass 3 to 6 sections of 2 to 4 short points, and 3 to 6 multiple-choice practice questions of your own, each with its answer index, a one-line why, and the index of the section it tests. Never copy, answer or hint at the lesson's own Ed quiz questions: Ed marks them. Then say one line and let the user work; do not restate the guide. Cost: one Ed request.

lessonId.description: Ed lesson ID as returned by list_lessons.

quiz.description: Practice questions you wrote; never the lesson's own Ed quiz questions.

answer.description: Zero-based index of the correct option.

options.description: Two to five answer choices, shown in this order.

question.description: The question, in one or two sentences.

section.description: Zero-based index of the section this question tests.

why.description: One line on why the answer is right.

points.description: Two to four short key points, each a full sentence.
